name: bitagents
description: BIT Agents repository with standalone frontend, worker, and shared package folders.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,worker -c coral,cyan "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix workers/provider-worker run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix shared run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix workers/provider-worker run typecheck
